font-size.$description: Tailwind CSS default font sizes and paired line heights (--text-*, --text-*--line-height)

letter-spacing.$description: Tailwind CSS default letter-spacing (tracking). em values mapped to rem per DTCG dimension units.

line-height.$description: Tailwind CSS default unitless line heights (leading)
